sloka: सा त्वेवमुक्ता वैदेही त्वनसूया ऽनसूयया ।प्रतिपूज्य वचो मन्दं प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥ २.११८.१॥
transliteration: sā tvevamuktā vaidehī tvanasūyā 'nasūyayā ।pratipūjya vaco mandaṁ pravaktumupacakrame ॥ 2.118.1॥

translations.english: When Anasuya thus addressed Vaidehi who is free from any malice, she worshipped Anasuya and started speaking in a gentle tone.
